subject: Re: Kickoff: depth from unknown cameras (video-in-the-wild)
body:
Lucia,

Allocations, as requested, explicit:

May-June: Quentin 60% on the masking pipeline (we need moving objects masked out of every training triplet, so this is the critical path), Rosa 50% on the data plumbing and TFRecord generation, Wanjiru 40% on serving experiments, Katya 20% advisory since she is deep on the sister depth track.

July: Rafael Duran is committed at 60% to this project for July 2026 to run the learned-intrinsics ablation study. That ablation -- learned vs. specified intrinsics across camera types -- is the centerpiece of the LRB readout, and Rafael wrote the original intrinsics code, so I want him properly resourced, not squeezed in at 20%.

Compute: 48 A100s on Titan, short runs from an ImageNet checkpoint.

Alina
